name: Oil India Ltd.
business_summary: Second-largest Indian upstream PSU: ~3.4 Mt crude and ~3.2 BCM gas per year from Assam, Rajasthan and the Andamans, owns 69.6% of Numaligarh Refinery (NRL, 3 MMTPA, expanding), the Assam–Siliguri crude pipeline and overseas minority stakes (Russia, Mozambique, Libya). Government holds 56.7% (promoter); FII 7.2%; DII 20.7%. Q1 FY27 delivered record standalone PAT Rs 2,870 cr (consolidated Rs 4,027 cr), crude output +11%. Realisations track Brent; domestic gas price is administered.

revenue_mix.geography: India (sold to Indian refiners at Brent-linked price)

exposures.mechanism: Crude sales ~3.4 Mt/yr (25m bbl) at ~$95 = Rs 22k cr; +10% realisation = +Rs 2.2k cr (net of ~20% royalty/cess = Rs 1.8k cr) = +13% of normalised consolidated EBITDA Rs 13.7k cr x EV/MCap 1.15 x persistence 0.4 => +6.9; NRL (refinery) and gas pricing offset slightly; haircut for windfall-tax risk => +5.0. Pack elasticity +4.52 (t +5.7) agrees; chosen central is shrunk modestly toward fundamentals.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 standalone PAT Rs2,870 cr record, consolidated Rs4,027 cr; crude output +11% (Business Standard, BusinessLine, CNBC TV18)

exposures.mechanism: Via 69.6% subsidiary NRL (Numaligarh, 3 MMTPA, expanding to 9 MMTPA by ~2028, model knowledge): +$2 x 22m bbl = $44m = Rs 415 cr = 3% EBITDA x 1.15 x 0.3 => +1.0. Pack +3.45 (t +4.5) reflects Brent collinearity (HO=F proxy) already in the Brent edge.
Crude and part of gas priced off USD benchmarks: INR 3% weaker raises realisation 3% = Rs 0.69k cr = +5% of EBITDA x 1.15 x persistence 0.5 => +2.9. Pack +3.87 (t +1.6) agrees.

Domestic gas (~3.2 BCM) is sold at APM/ceiling-linked formulae with caps, so only the new-gas premium reacts: +15% LNG => +1.5% revenue-equivalent, mostly capped => +0.3. Pack -0.81 (t -1.2) is insignificant (Henry Hub proxy).

+1 = SAED reimposed at ~Rs 10,000/tonne on domestic crude. 3.4 Mt x Rs 10,000 = Rs 340 cr = 2.5% EBITDA x 1.15 x persistence 0.5 => -1.4; add probability of a larger rate => -1.8. Govt is already reshuffling windfall levies on product exports (Aug-Oct 2026).

evidence.note: Upstream vs downstream PSU energy: $100 crude splits India's oil sector (Value Research)

exposures.mechanism: Debt Rs ~21k cr (interest Rs 302 cr/qtr): 25bp floating share 50% = Rs 26 cr = 0.7% of PBT; plus PSU dividend-yield discount effect => -0.5.
Escalation => Brent +12% => +6 via Brent edge; no Gulf-dependent assets or sales; some risk-off market impact. Mozambique Area-1 LNG (4% stake via OVL consortium) delay risk negligible. Net +4.5.

evidence.note: Upstream vs downstream PSU energy: $100 crude splits India's oil sector (Value Research)

exposures.mechanism: OIL holds minority stakes (via consortium with IOC/BPCL/OVL) in Vankor, Taas-Yuryakh (model knowledge); easing sanctions would unlock dividends/ asset value; +1 ~ $300m asset-value release = Rs 2.8k cr = 4% of market cap Rs 70k cr x 0.25 probability-adj => +1.0. US tariff threats on Russia-linked trade cut this.
Pack shows +4.14 (t +1.6): spurious (Fed and Brent correlation) - weight zero; no fundamental link beyond global liquidity.
